observed_patterns.text_density: Most competing thumbnails use 2-4 large words. Top performers keep it minimal for mobile readability at 60+ viewer age.
observed_patterns.emotional_tone: Two clear camps: (A) fear-framing ('交通事故の3倍', '命の危険') and (B) calm educational ('知っておきたい', '簡単対策'). Camp A gets initial clicks but lower retention for senior audiences.
observed_patterns.visual_simplicity: Successful senior-health channels use clean backgrounds, single focal object, high contrast. Cluttered thumbnails underperform.
observed_patterns.host_usage: Professional channels use face + white coat (authority). Illustration-style channels use no-host object scenes. Both work for different strategies.
observed_patterns.danger_framing_vs_calm: Fear-framing dominates search results but violates kenh_2 policy (fear_intensity_ceiling=low). Calm educational framing is safer and matches channel voice.
observed_patterns.number_usage: Numbers in titles are very effective (e.g., '3つ', '5選'). Almost all top results use number anchors.
observed_patterns.promise_style: Overpromise is common ('これだけで安心', '転倒ゼロへ'). kenh_2 must avoid these per policy. Safer framing: '見直し', '確認', 'ポイント'.

likely_fit_for_this_channel: Calm domestic object-focused thumbnail (dressing room corner with mat + heater + stool)
Number anchor in title (3つ) — matches script structure exactly
Warm earth-tone soft illustration style — unique differentiator vs photo-heavy competitors
Practical framing: '見直し' / '確認' without fear
Minimal text overlay (3-4 words max) for senior readability
likely_mismatch_for_this_channel: Fear-based thumbnails with shocked expressions or red alarm icons
White-coat authority framing (channel has no medical host)
Photo-heavy realistic thumbnails (channel is illustrated style)
Dense text overlays (5+ words) that are hard to read on mobile
Overpromise phrasing ('これで安全', '事故ゼロ')
things_to_avoid: Fear imagery or alarm icons (violates fear_intensity_ceiling=low)
Overpromise claims in title or thumbnail (violates forbidden_claims)
Medical authority framing without actual credentials (misleading)
Photorealistic thumbnail when channel style is illustrated
Disease-name shock bait in title (forbidden hook pattern)
English text on thumbnail (ja-JP only channel)
